Expand our future. 10.06.2026 ispace and ArianeGroup Sign Agreement for Strategic Collaboration to Advance Lunar Spacecraft Development In 2022, we launched our first mission to the Moon. It was the culmination of years of hard work and our first step towards extending human life into outer space. About our company Mission 2.5 Leveraging our global presence, we aim to meet the needs of our customers with tailored solutions developed through our own spaceflight heritage, in conjunction with input from our network of experts around the globe. Learn more Mission 3 Mission 3 will be the first mission to feature ispace’s new ULTRA lunar lander, a larger and more capable lander design. Learn more M1 – Japan 2022 M2 – Japan 2025 M2.5 – U.S.A 2027 M3 – JAPAN 2028 M4 – JAPAN 2029 Today, we continue our quest to provide high-frequency, low-cost transportation services to the lunar surface and lunar orbit. We aim to deliver the building blocks that will enable mankind’s journey to the Moon and beyond. More about our Missions ispace Vision Join us as we boldly pave the way to a sustainable cislunar economy. Learn more Expand our planet Expand our future Our vision is to extend the sphere of human life into space and create a sustainable world by providing high-frequency, low-cost transportation services to the Moon. Toward that vision, we aim to build an economic zone in the space between the Earth and the Moon (cislunar) through the commercialization of lunar surface development. Join us on the Lunar Quest! Explore our spacecraft INVESTOR RELATIONS We are supported by many stakeholders, including our investors, payload customers, governments and suppliers. Discover Investor Relations Exciting things are happening daily at ispace. Check out the latest news and updates from our global entities. Read all news & updates Corporate 10.06.2026 ispace and ArianeGroup Sign Agreement for Strategic Collaboration to Advance Lunar Spacecraft Development Learn More Learn More Corporate 10.06.2026 ispace, Leonardo and Telespazio Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Collaborate on Lunar Exploration Learn More Learn More Mission 09.17.2026 Argo Space and ispace-U.S. Head to the Moon with Finalized Contract for Lunar Satellite Delivery “Mission 2.5” Learn More Learn More Finance 09.09.2026 ispace Secures Approximately $19 Million in Bank Financing from Shizuoka Bank Learn More Learn More Mission 09.02.2026 ESA and ispace-EUROPE Mark Official Signing of Europe’s First Lunar Polar Ice Exploration Rover Mission Learn More Learn More Career Build the future with us. Join us Our Story ispace is building the cislunar economy and a sustainable future on Earth. Learn more about our story Learn more about ispace and our lunar quest. Why the Moon? We view the Moon as an opportunity. It is an opportunity to expand human existence into space and we believe the Moon is a stepping-stone to Mars and deeper space exploration. It is our first step to establishing human existence beyond the confines of Earth. Where are ispace offices located? We are a global company with entities in Japan, the United States and Luxembourg, ready to serve customers in each market. What does ispace do? ispace is a lunar transportation company with a vision to expand human presence beyond the Earth. We are building lunar landers to transport customer payloads to lunar orbit and the surface. In addition, we design lunar rovers to explore the Moon. Our goal is to deliver and develop the infrastructure necessary to support human life on the Moon. Is ispace a publicly traded company? Yes, ispace is publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Growth Market. In October 2024, ispace was selected for the TSE Growth Market Core Index. Interested in ispace and the services we offer?
